# Judith Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_003_page_001.jpg

---

**3:1** And they-sent messengers to him for words of peace, saying:

**3:2** "Behold, we the-servants of Nebuchadnezzar the-great king lie-prostrate before-you — use us as it-is-pleasing in-your sight.

**3:3** Behold, our-buildings and every-[piece-of] land of-ours and every-field of-wheat and our-flocks and our-herds and all-the folds of-our-tents — they-lie before your face; use [them] as is-pleasing in-your sight.

**3:4** Behold, also our-cities and those-dwelling in them are your slaves — come and deal with them as [is] good in-your eyes."

**3:5** And the-men came to Holofernes and they-reported to him according to all these words.

**3:6** And he-came-down to the-seacoast, he and his army, and he-garrisoned the-high-walled cities and took from them chosen men as auxiliaries.

**3:7** And they-received him and all-the country around them with garlands and with dances and with tambourines.

**3:8** And he-tore-down all their borders and cut-down their sacred-groves, for it-had-been-given to him to-destroy all-the gods of-the land, so-that all-the nations would-serve Nebuchadnezzar alone, and [so-that] all-their tongues and all-their tribes would-call-upon him as god.

**3:9** And he-came to Esdraelon, near Dothan which faces the-great ridge of Judea.

**3:10** And he-encamped between Geba and Scythopolis, and he-was-there one-month of-days, in-order-to gather all-the supplies of his army.
